headline: Sales and profit grow but operating profit misses forecasts
summary_short: Revenue was KRW 1,740.6B (+7.2% y/y) and operating profit KRW 243.5B (+10.8% y/y, margin 14.0%); EPS was KRW 23,584, up 46.2% y/y.
summary_long: EPS of KRW 23,584 rose 27.2% q/q and 46.2% y/y. Preliminary figures put revenue at KRW 1,740.6B and operating profit at KRW 243.5B, down from KRW 264.2B in Q2. Pre-tax continuing profit was KRW 280.2B, up 43.3% y/y. Brokers say operating profit was about 20% below consensus. Guidance is not assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Figures are preliminary and from StockHub's summary of the filing. EPS is Yahoo data.
